text: You didn't open all those tabs for no reason. You just don't need them all right now. Tabosmart brings related work together, and helps you review repeat pages. Save links for later. Close only what you choose. Recovery reopens URLs, not unsaved edits. Your browsing data stays on your device. Optional local AI adds suggestions and group names, on supported Chrome devices. The core works without it. I'm building Tabosmart with the people using it. Tell me what missed the point, or what would make it useful tomorrow. Less tab clutter. More headspace.
